Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses AP-MS (Immunoprecipitation) to study protein interactions and specific PTMs (hydroxylation of Trp, Asp, and Asn). While the study focuses on hydroxylation, it does not use a general PTM enrichment method like TiO2 or IMAC, but rather target-specific enrichment via IP of the NAA10/NAA15 complexes.

scope: In order to enrich NAA10-V5, NAA15-V5, or NAA15 and any bound proteins, IP was performed in lysate from cells transfected with NAA10-V5, NAA15-V5, or untransfected cells.
NAA10 or NAA15 immunoprecipitated from HEK293, HeLa and HAP1 cells were analyzed for interactors and hydroxylation at tryptophan, aspartate and asparagine residues.
